after.worked_solution:
First, we get the minor corresponding to ${c}_{21}$, removing the $2$nd row and the $1$st column:

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 2 & 1 & -2 \\ ∗ & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{21}=|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${c}_{21}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{21} & =(-1)^{2+1}{M}_{21} \\  & =-{M}_{21} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
Q=[\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & 2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 3 & 5 & 0 & 9 & ∗ \\ 15 & -1 & -5 & 6 & ∗ \\ 4 & -4 & 3 & 8 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{55}=|\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & 2 & 0 \\ 3 & 5 & 0 & 9 \\ 15 & -1 & -5 & 6 \\ 4 & -4 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${q}_{55}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{55} & =(-1)^{5+5}{M}_{55} \\  & ={M}_{55} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & 2 & 0 \\ 3 & 5 & 0 & 9 \\ 15 & -1 & -5 & 6 \\ 4 & -4 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
